events.event: Bank Indonesia reported its October 2026 Consumer Confidence Index (IKK) rose to 119.9 from 118.1 in September, with only the above-Rp5 million spending group seeing confidence fall.
events.key_numbers: IKK 119.9 (Sep 118.1) · current conditions index 109.1 · expectations index 130.7 (from 128.7) · job availability index 105.5 · Rp1-2 million group 107.6, current conditions 98.5 (pessimistic) · above Rp5 million group 123.0 (from 123.5)
events.why_it_matters: Households say they feel more confident even as the rupiah weakens, but the lowest-spending group still rates its current conditions below 100.

events.event: Markets priced a 91% probability of a Fed rate hike in December 2026, with the US dollar index near 103, its highest since April 2025, after US October CPI beat expectations.
events.key_numbers: Fed December hike probability 91% · possible further hikes Jan and Apr 2027 priced · DXY about 103, up more than 1% on 12 Nov · US October CPI +0.4% m/m vs 0.3% consensus
events.why_it_matters: A stronger dollar and US rate hikes push the rupiah toward new lows, which raises prices of imported goods and fuel.
